title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Credit Risk Standard — Holds, Releases and Charge-Off
content:
The standing of a Ridgeline Pro Credit account is changed only by the system, from statement and balance records.

## Placing an account on hold

| Hold reason | Placed on hold when |
|---|---|
| Past due | A statement of an active account shows days past due at or above the tier's on-hold days past due |
| Over limit | The balance of an active account exceeds the credit line by more than the tier's over-limit tolerance percentage |
| Sister account hold | As the relationship cross-default sets it: the business's other account was placed on hold |

## Release

- An account on hold for past due is released only when every past-due amount is paid.
- An account on hold for over limit is released when the balance is back within the credit line.
- A partial payment never releases a hold.

## Charge-off

An account on hold is charged off when a statement shows days past due at or above the tier's charge-off days past due, and it is referred to collections.

## What Customer Care can and cannot do

Customer Care cannot release a hold early or reverse a charge-off. A payment that clears the past-due amount is credited, and the release follows from the records.

## Hypothetical cases (Commercial Account Net 30 Select, hold at 45 days, charge-off at 180)

| Latest statement | Status before | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 44 days past due | Active | Stays active |
| 45 days past due | Active | Placed on hold for past due |
| 180 days past due | On hold | Charged off |
| Business pays 70 percent of the past-due amount | On hold for past due | Stays on hold |
